title: Drones strike Saratov oil refinery and Ozon warehouse overnight
detail: Ukrainian drones struck Russia's Saratov region overnight on Sept 8, hitting the Rosneft-owned Saratov oil refinery (annual capacity roughly 4.8 million tonnes) and igniting a fire at a nearby Ozon e-commerce logistics warehouse. Independent Russian OSINT outlet ASTRA geolocated the fire to the refinery grounds. Saratov Oblast Governor Roman Busargin said ten people were injured, including three children, with six hospitalized though none in life-threatening condition; he attributed the injuries to falling drone debris rather than the refinery blast itself. The refinery had previously been struck on July 8, when its only crude distillation unit was damaged and processing was halted.
